subject: Embedding validity deep-dive: model recs, benchmarks & PoC next steps
summary: Post-demo follow-up capturing model recommendations for Searchly's semantic search PoC, benchmark artifacts, dimensionality concerns, and agreed next steps for a 2-week pilot.
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Alexa Martin <alexa@searchly.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Apr 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Embedding validity deep-dive: model recs, benchmarks & PoC next steps

Hi Alexa — thanks again for the demo today. Quick recap and a proposed runbook so we can get a short PoC running next week.

Call highlights
- Primary goal: semantic search over mixed doc corpus (kb articles, product sheets, support tickets) for relevancy and de-duplication.
- Key constraints: 1) need recall in top-10 >= 0.78 for business queries, 2) 95th percentile embed+nearest-neighbor latency under 45ms in-app, 3) low serving cost target (~$0.008 per query).

Recommended models (initial + fallbacks)
- Primary: rw-embed-large-v1 (1536-d) — best balance of precision and robustness on mixed-domain corpora.
- Cost-sensitive variant: rw-embed-quant-s2 (768-d, int8) — ~30-40% cheaper with small drop in MRR for shorter docs.
- Fallback (cold-start): open-embed-3B-lite (1024-d) — used only for archived-heavy queries to reduce cold-miss risk.

Key evaluation lenses and artifacts we will provide
- Offline metrics: Recall@10, MRR, NDCG@10 on your 1k query sampler (we ran preliminary checks).
- Dimensionality check: PCA explained-variance plots + nearest-neighbor density distributions (to detect hubness).
- Drift guardrail: batch embedding comparison and cosine shift thresholds; we suggest alerting if mean cosine to previous baseline shifts > 0.03.

Attachments and links
- I attached three artifacts: a compact benchmark CSV with the pilot's summary results, the prompt/query set we propose to use, and a short runbook for deployment. Drive links in metadata above.

Proposed PoC success criteria (helps procurement/engineering align)
1) Recall@10 >= 0.78 on the agreed query set.
2) End-to-end (embed + ANN) 95th percentile latency < 45ms in your staging env.
3) Evidence of stable embeddings across a 48-hour ingest window (cosine drift < 0.03).

Proposed next steps (timeline)
- Wed 04/04: We deliver the full CSV bench + prompt set (attached).
- Thu 04/05: Redwood SRE provides a small staging job to validate latency with your vector DB.
- Fri 04/12: 2-week pilot kickoff (data load + daily short QC checks).

Can you confirm procurement contact and whether your staging environment has a GPU instance for ANN (we can also run hosted for the PoC if preferred)?

Thanks — looking forward to getting this running.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Embedding validity deep-dive: model recs, benchmarks & PoC next steps

Hi Alexa — looping in a few technical details and attachments for your engineers. Attached: searchly-embed-bench-20280403.csv (summary metrics), prompt-sets-searchly-v1.jsonl, and a short runbook (embed-runbook-searchly.pdf).

Quick tech notes:
- Precision table (excerpt in CSV): rw-embed-large-v1: P@10=0.71, rw-embed-quant-s2: P@10=0.66, open-embed-3B-lite: P@10=0.60 (these are on your 1k query sampler).
- Dimensionality: rw-embed-large-v1 (1536 dims) shows higher pairwise separability; however we observed slight hubness on short ticket texts. We recommend L2-normalization + small PCA (retain 95% variance) as a pre-index step for ANN to reduce hub effects.
- Drift detection: we propose a nightly job that computes mean cosine and 90th percentile cosine change vs baseline. Alert threshold: mean shift > 0.03 OR 90th percentile shift > 0.06.
- ANN config we tested: HNSW with M=32, efConstruction=200, efSearch=100 gave stable recall/latency tradeoffs in our staging runs.

Notes on attachments:
- searchly-embed-bench-20280403.csv: contains model, recall@k, precision@k, MRR, latency (median/95th), dimensionality stats (mean L2, variance explained).
- prompt-sets-searchly-v1.jsonl: set of 1k anonymized queries we used for the bench. Please do not publish.
- embed-runbook-searchly.pdf: short instructions for running the sample job and validating metrics in your environment.

If you want, we can schedule a 30-minute handoff between your engineering lead and our SRE to align ANN tuning.

—Neha Kapoor
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
